_comment: Drop a copy of this at <workspace>/.cc/config.json (without the _comment fields) to override auto-detection. All fields are optional — auto-detection covers most projects.
_comment_dev_server_url: Used by /browser-test to find the running app. Falls back to: env DEV_SERVER_URL → package.json scripts → framework config files → :3000.
_comment_browser_test_root: Where per-phase test markdown + Playwright specs are emitted. Relative to workspace root. Default: 'docs/e2e-testing'.
_comment_browser_test_allow_remote: If true, allow targeting non-localhost URLs (staging). Default false — refuses to run against remote without explicit opt-in.
_comment_static: Static checks run BEFORE unit tests in the verify gate. Each command runs in workspace root. Fail-fast on first non-zero exit.
_comment_test_commands: Unit + integration test commands. Run AFTER static, before browser-test. Fail-fast. Override auto-detection.
_comment_coverage_min: Minimum total coverage % required. Enforced if a test command emits a coverage summary. Default: 0 (no enforcement).
_comment_skip_tests_on: Phases whose directive starts with one of these conventional-commits prefixes can skip the test stage. Use sparingly. Default: [].
_comment_skip_static_on: Same as skip_tests_on but for static checks. Default: []
_comment_auth: Persistent browser session for auth-gated apps. login_flow_path is a markdown describing the one-time login (Cowork drives it once, persists state). Env vars hold the actual credentials (never commit them).
_comment_browser_test_excluded_phases: Phase numbers that have no user-visible surface (pure backend migration, internal refactor). Skipped from browser-test step. Still logged with phase_browser_test_skipped reason='no-ui-surface'.
